versions.changelog:
Initial release of “内容裂变工厂”:

- Enables full automation for trending topic selection, AI-driven analysis, viral article creation, knowledge card generation, and cross-platform publishing (WeChat, Feishu).
- Integrates multiple skills: Agent-Reach (hotspot capture), summarize (trend analysis & suggestions), card-renderer (stylish info cards), wechat-article-pro (deep-dive posts), feishu_doc (archival).
- Supports command triggers, manual & scheduled execution, and custom configuration.
- Provides robust workflow steps with error handling and troubleshooting guidance.
- Designed for efficiency: minimizes manual effort, maximizes content originality and team knowledge accumulation.
